author: Good Enough
description:
If a mountain lion attacks you, making the wrong move could put you in even greater danger.

Mountain lions are powerful ambush predators capable of incredible speed, strength, and agility. This video explains what to do during a mountain lion attack, the mistakes that can make the situation worse, and how to improve your chances of escaping safely.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of North America's most dangerous predators and what experts recommend if you ever encounter one in the wild.
title: If a Mountain Lion Attacks You, Do This 🐆😲 #animals #wildlife #survival #outdoors
